the novel component of AMP deaminate is a histidine-pro-line-rich-glycoprotein (HPRG)-like protein and is associated to AMP deaminase.
the HPRG-like molecule is a component of AMP deamination in skeletal muscle and that it is liberated from the protein complex by proteolytic cleavage during the isolation procedure.

the novel component of skeletal-muscle deaminase has an amino acid composition and an N-terminal sequence similar to those of histidine-proline-glycoprotein, and that this component is associated to the enzyme as a result of proteolytic processing during its purification from muscle.
